description: Retrieve the password of a standalone/legacy managed service account bound to a host.

telemetry.detail: If retrieved from LSASS/registry on the host, ProcessAccess to lsass.exe may fire.
sMSA retrieval is uncommon and stands out where host telemetry is collected.

prerequisite_privilege: Local admin / SYSTEM on the host the sMSA is installed on
abuse_primitive: Extract the sMSA secret from the host, reuse the account.
notes: Host-local retrieval; noise tracks whatever credential-access method is used on the box.
